title: chrysanthemum tanacetoides
intro: Chrysanthemum tanacetoides, commonly known as Yellow Flower or Tanacetum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum tanacetoides include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-bacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
